title: A new-topic research worker's brief and turn cap fit its scope, so it does not run out at 200 turns
goal: dispatch gives a research item that creates a new topic a turn cap and brief guidance sized to its question count (a figure measured from SP-5dffnlxn's workers, whose new-topic items used 141 to 200 turns, one reaching the 200 cap), so a worker finishes its report and checks before the cap.

run:
import sys, tempfile, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base, bl_dispatch
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
bl_base.load_settings(d)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir()), exist_ok=True)

def put(iid, n):
    qs = " ".join(f"Question {i}: what does feature {i} of the product do?" for i in range(1, n + 1))
    item = {"id": iid, "kind": "story", "title": "research a new topic", "status": "doing", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": qs, "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["kb/public/zz/new-topic.md"]}
    open(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir(), iid + ".json"), "w").write(json.dumps(item))
put("ST-aaaaaaaa", 2)
put("ST-bbbbbbbb", 8)
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
small, big = bl_dispatch.max_turns(bl, "ST-aaaaaaaa"), bl_dispatch.max_turns(bl, "ST-bbbbbbbb")
print("turn cap for 2 questions:", small, "for 8 questions:", big)
sys.exit(0 if big > small else 1)
